source.name: Dubai Media Office, Emirates tips-off as the Official Main Sponsor of Real Madrid Basketball
source.quote: As part of the agreement, Emirates’ ‘Fly Better’ branding will prominently feature on the jerseys
source.note: Emirates 'Fly Better' on player jerseys (Official Main Sponsor, multi-year, from September 2025). Seen on the front of the 2026/27 home jersey in official product photos and game photos (September 2026).

summary: Emirates 'Fly Better' is the only commercial sponsor on the 2026/27 home kit, on the front of the jersey. Checked every placement: sleeveless jersey, back carries only the player name and number (retail product photos front and back, plus the retailer description, show nothing else), shorts carry no sponsor (25/26 retail shorts and September 2026 game photos show only the club crest, adidas mark and competition badges). The Liga Endesa / EuroLeague chest badge is a competition mark, not a sponsor.
